issue.title: sase screenshot never settles with a prompt open: prompt-input artifact-change defer re-arms a 0.25s one-shot timer forever
issue.description:
Found by the sase-1dq land agent during the plan's live `sase screenshot` walk (2026-10-01, athena, master 0abe894140).

Root cause: while a prompt input is open, `_on_artifact_change` (src/sase/ace/tui/actions/event_refresh/_watcher.py ~line 71) parks changed paths and schedules a `PROMPT_INPUT_DEFER_SECONDS` (0.25 s) one-shot `set_timer`. `_on_artifact_change_deferred` clears the pending flag and re-enters `_on_artifact_change`, which re-defers while the prompt is still open (5ca849369c, by design). After any artifact change, AceApp therefore holds a perpetually re-armed 0.25 s one-shot timer for as long as the prompt stays open. The live-capture settling probe added in 951b7c9068 (`_pending_settling_work` in src/sase/ace/tui/actions/screenshot_export.py) treats every one-shot timer of 0.5 s or less with an unfinished task as pending work. So the export never sees stable frames and times out: "stable_frames=0/3; frame_digests=[]; pending_one_shot_timers=['set_timer#1']". A set_timer trace confirmed AceApp set_timer#1 0.25 from _watcher.py:77 <- _on_artifact_change_deferred, re-armed about 4 times a second with the prompt open and idle.

Fix direction: either exempt the prompt-input artifact-defer timer from screenshot settling (name it, as debouncers are named), or stop polling, i.e. park the deferred paths and flush them when the prompt closes. That removes the 4 Hz wakeups while typing too. Add a test that an open prompt with deferred artifact changes still reaches export readiness.

task_type_fields.impact: Live sase screenshot captures of any prompt-input flow (next-word ghosts and peeks, completion menus, prompt stack) fail on a busy host, so agents fall back to tmux text captures; idle open prompts also wake the app about 4 times a second.
task_type_fields.repro: Launch sase screenshot --keep on a host with ongoing agent artifact writes, press Space then Ctrl+U to open an empty prompt, then run sase screenshot --window <target> -o /tmp/x.png. It times out with pending_one_shot_timers=['set_timer#1'], and the capture succeeds once the prompt is closed.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1dq land agent's live screenshot walk could not capture any PNG with the prompt open on athena. Every open-prompt capture timed out on a perpetually pending one-shot timer, which blocks live visual verification of prompt features.
